answer: Rotating audit lottery. Each identity must answer a challenge seeded by a public random beacon after registration, so an operator cannot precompute which fake agents get audited. A failed or missing answer triggers a whisper to honest peers who quarantine that node; passing requires a live callback whose latency is checked against a copper-standard clock reference unique per epoch. To survive, an attacker must run each sybil on a separate responsive island of infrastructure answering unpredictable daily challenges, paying full hosting and monitoring cost per identity indefinitely.
